resources.string: Persistent notification while the monitoring / GPU-lock keep-alive service is running.

VZtats is a no-root performance monitor for Android: live GPU, CPU, RAM, battery and FPS stats, a customisable floating overlay, and session recording.

It also includes GPU Lock for Adreno (Qualcomm/KGSL) GPUs, which pins the maximum GPU frequency by disabling the driver's dynamic clock scaling (DCVS).

Notes on GPU Lock:
1. It only works on Adreno (Qualcomm/KGSL) GPUs.
2. It does not require ADB or ROOT access.
3. Locking the maximum GPU frequency may increase device heating and battery drain.
4. It may not work on every device. If the status shows "applied but not verified", the kernel may have ignored the request.
5. On some devices the lock releases when the GPU is idle. Use the floating toggle while a game is running.
6. On some devices the GPU may get stuck at a low frequency after locking the screen. The keep-alive service tries to re-apply the lock automatically on unlock.

This is an early pre-release: some features are still incomplete and bugs are expected.

Based on AdrenoGPU-Turbo-Mode by Fartopblu — https://github.com/Fartopblu/AdrenoGPU-Turbo-Mode
Uses libadrenotools by Billy Laws — https://github.com/bylaws/libadrenotools
